backup.restore_point: PENDING - take a fresh backup, re-read the clock, then fill both fields (fill-restore-point.mjs does it)
backup.production_rule: Expand only: one new read-only function public.price_advisor_inputs_v1(uuid, date, date), granted to authenticated only. No table, column or data change. restore_point and verified_at are placeholders for the orchestrator. Take a fresh backup if the one named is more than an hour old at apply time.

forward_verification.name: function_exists_definer_stable_empty_search_path
forward_verification.query: select count(*) = 1 and bool_and(p.prosecdef and p.provolatile = 's' and p.proconfig = array['search_path=""']) from pg_proc p where p.pronamespace = 'public'::regnamespace and p.proname = 'price_advisor_inputs_v1'

forward_verification.name: grants_authenticated_only_anon_and_public_none
forward_verification.query: select has_function_privilege('authenticated','public.price_advisor_inputs_v1(uuid,date,date)','execute') and not has_function_privilege('anon','public.price_advisor_inputs_v1(uuid,date,date)','execute') and not exists (select 1 from pg_proc p, aclexplode(p.proacl) a where p.oid = 'public.price_advisor_inputs_v1(uuid,date,date)'::regprocedure and a.grantee = 0)

forward_verification.name: function_body_only_reads
forward_verification.query: select count(*) = 1 and bool_and(p.prosrc !~* 'insert into|update public|delete from|truncate|drop |alter table') from pg_proc p where p.pronamespace = 'public'::regnamespace and p.proname = 'price_advisor_inputs_v1'

steps.name: run_compensating_script
steps.action: Apply supabase/rollbacks/20261006_price_advisor_inputs.sql with run-sql-on-host.sh: it drops the function. No data is touched. Roll the admin dashboard back too (the Price advisor page calls the function).

feature_flags.name: sql_then_app
feature_flags.required_state: Apply this release BEFORE the admin dashboard build that adds the Price advisor page is published: the page calls price_advisor_inputs_v1 and shows an error until it exists.

compatibility.rehearsal: NOT YET RUN (session 72 lane L7). The orchestrator rehearses on a restored backup: 1/1 migration, 3/3 forward checks, pgTAP price_advisor_inputs 54/54 (includes a cleaner and an owner without the second factor being refused). The function body was not executed by the lane builder: no local Postgres.
compatibility.evidence: Production read-only (2026-10-06): airbnb_reservations, booking_inquiries, calendar_events (block_reason, block_reason_source), transactions and acct_settings have the columns the function reads; no function with this name exists. Nothing reads or writes the function except the new dashboard page; old readers and writers are unaffected.

stop_conditions: any forward verification query returns anything other than its expected value
the restore point is older than one hour
restore_point or verified_at is still empty or still the PENDING placeholder
the rehearsal has not run the pgTAP suite green on this commit
the admin dashboard build is published before this release is applied
